branches.conclusion: The Institute of Supply Chain Analytics 2027 direct-doctoral admission notice now identifies its one doctorate explicitly as 智慧供应链与物流管理 (Smart Supply Chain and Logistics Management). This is a distinct institute offering, not an alias of the Management Science and Engineering School 1201Z2 code by assumption. The institute programme title and its named doctoral direction list lack Operations, Management Science or Industrial Engineering; broad institute research interests in OM/OR do not convert the programme to a qualifying route. Other business doctoral named fields still require review.
